[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] '''Vehicle Flamer'''<ref name="ROE" /> was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] that could be mounted on a vehicle such as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> They cost around 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and had a range of twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Vehicle Flamers were used to take out buildings and eliminate full [[Squad/Legends|squads]].<ref name="ROE" />
